tei:div.tei:p: (133)mkhyen brtse mo nos gzigs pas rjes bzung zhing*/ rnam dag lam gyi dmigs rnams rab phye nas/ sems rgyud dam pa'i chos la 'khrid mjad pa/ bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ bu khyod snying nas thar bar 'jug 'dod na/ dang po rang rgyud rtog dpyod gal che bas/ chos ldan rten la sems kyi 'jug tshul gsum/ mi dge bar ma dge ba'i rtog pa gsum/ ngan rtog sems la dran pa'i bya ra btang*/ chags sdang gar skyes 'bur 'joms ma byas na/ tshogs sbyor dus na ci bsam cha med pas/ stong lta mthon pos ngan rtog thub pa dkon/ nyon mongs phyogs kyi khrod na gnas dus 'dir/ 'khrul dbang mi btang sran gzung yid brtan na/ rtag cing tshugs thub nyon mongs su la srid/ rnam kun rang rgyud skya dri yal lam blta/ chos la zhugs nas yun ring lon na yang*/ tha mal skye bo'i bsam spyod mi 'gal bar/ rang (134)dgar pho chod chos pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis/ 'di phyi gnyis kar rang gzhan phong ta re/ nang nas nyon mongs dgra ru ma mthong na/ bla ma bzang dang gdams ngag zab pas ci/ rang la rang rgyud mngon sum rus che bas/ nyon mongs gang che gnyen po brten pa zab/ deng sang dus na snyigs ma'i mngon rtog mthus/ rang rgyud mi 'byor kha lta mtho khyad kyis/ rgyal khams zog pos khyab la nye ba'i dus/ lta ba'i mtho khyad skyur la sems rgyud 'di/ gang phan blo ldog rnam bzhi ma bsam na/ chos gzhung shor bas chos la skye bton kyang*/ blo skyed med pas tha mal lus la nye/ btang snyoms lung ma bstan du mu 'byams nas/ za nyal le lo skyid 'dod ri la bzung*/ ltar snang dge ba'i tshul 'chos bzang na yang*/ thar ba'i lam gyi sa bon thob pa dkon/ bslu med dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum la/ snying nas yid ches dad pa skye ba 'di/ nor dang gter bzhin chos kyi gzhi ma yin/ (135)rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad pa tshul bzhin brten/ rang rgyud las dang nyon mongs gyis bskyed pa'i/

srid gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gzhol 'dod na/ bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos kyi nyams len dgos/ dal 'byor rin chen chos kyi rten bzang po/ rgyu dpe grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed dka' zhing*/ phyi nas 'di 'dra cis kyang rnyed dka' bas/ snying po 'bong*/ gsum dam pa'i chos la thon/ pang bya gnang bya'i ngang du dus dron na/ mi tshe los 'jad la zla zhag gis 'jad/ skad cig re bzhin mi yi tshe zad nas/ 'chi bdag lag tu cis kyang 'gro ba som/ 'chi tsam 'ong ba kun gyi shes na yang*/ da dung mi 'chi snyams pa'i log rtog 'dis/ tshe 'di sgrub 'dod ngang du mi tshe zad/ nam 'chi ges med gnas 'dir yid la bsam/ 'chi tshe lus dang longs spyod gnyen bshes dang*/ thob dang mnga' thang stobs kyi phan pa med/ gces par bskyang ba'i lus kyang bzhag nas 'gro/ phan gnod bskyed pa dge sdig (136)gnyis las med/ gnas cha med pa'i stong pa'i sbad khams kyi/ dgos pa'i dus su mnyes po thub pa dkon/ lta bas ma zin sems gnas glen bsgom gyis/ dud 'gro'i gnas las gzhan du 'gro sa med/ stong nyid snying rje mnyams pa gon gnyis las/ snang stong re 'jog med pa nyams blang na/ rgyal sras spyod pa ji snyed 'di ru 'dus/ ya bral gcig shos nyams len byed mdog dang*/ zang thal mtho sgros kha pho mtho ba 'di/ skyi 'chi'i 'gags la tha mal las kyang mod/ kye ma kye hud stong ltas ma brtsom gces/ 'go log mkhar nang bla ma kun dga'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel gyis bris so/
'di dpe lhag zhig gong na yod//
